correctness.rationale: At a full-support Boolean-relation idempotent e, a unit g of e B_X e cannot have an empty row (then gh=e would) or empty column (then hg=e would), and likewise for its inverse. Therefore H_e(M_X)=H_e(B_X) as subsets. Relational right action of local units on L(e) is an invertible join anti-action; setting rows of g to F(e_x) for an arbitrary join-automorphism and checking e g=g e=g, gh=hg=e establishes the converse (inversion converts anti- to homomorphism). For a poset, L(e_P) is its upper-set lattice and its principal-upper-set join irreducibles recover P. The explicit colored-height/chain-marker poset forces automorphisms to act as left translations of finite G and proves the claimed |G|(1+2d+d(d+1)/2) carrier size. Independent enumeration for n≤3 recovered 1,7,265 full-support relations and 1,4,35 idempotents and confirmed local-group-size agreement; infinite result follows structurally.
